name: Document Expiry Alert Report
query:
SELECT 
vd.parenttype AS "Vehicle Type:Data:150",
vd.parent AS "Vehicle No:Data:100",
vd.name1 AS "Document Type:Data:250",
vd.reference_number AS "Reference No:Data:200",
vd.issue_date AS "Issued On:Date:100",
vd.expire_date AS "Expiring On:Date:100" 
FROM `tabDocument Attachments` vd 
WHERE vd.expire_date <= date_add(curdate(),interval vd.send_alert_before day)
AND vd.expire_date IS NOT NULL 
AND vd.send_alert_before > 0 
ORDER BY vd.expire_date
